S1.why: A tile-row tag: '免费 5 个' is how a Chinese app labels a free allowance; 6 CJK budget held.

S2.why: A soft question is the native way to invite without pushing; uses the vocab word 剪切片段; 9 CJK.

S3.s: 你已存满 %lld 个免费剪切片段。它们会一直免费，照常可用。
S3.back: you already saved-full 5 (mw) free cut-clip-pieces. they will always free, as-usual usable.
S3.why: 存满 (filled up) names the state without blame; second sentence promises they stay free and keep working; 你 as Apple zh-Hans uses.

S4.s: 你可以免费保存 %lld 个剪切片段。
S4.why: Plain statement of the allowance; 保存 is the save verb used throughout.

S5.s: %2$lld 个免费剪切片段已用 %1$lld 个。
S5.why: Chinese states the whole first, then how much is used ('5 个名额已用 3 个'), so positional %2$/%1$ reverse the order.

S6.why: Bold row line, no period, a label not a sentence; 7 CJK plus the number.

S7.s: 最多可存 %@ 条文本和 %lld 张图片。
S7.back: at-most can store 5,000 (mw-strip) text and 500 (mw-sheet) images.
S7.why: Vocab kinds 文本 and 图片 with their native measure words 条 and 张, joined by 和.

S8.why: Chinese lists three with the enumeration comma 、 before 和, as Apple's zh-Hans pages write it; Latin-CJK spacing as in the vocab.

S9.s: 购买一次，登录同一 Apple 账户的所有设备都能用。
S9.back: buy one time, logged-in same Apple account's all devices all can use.
S9.why: Apple 账户 and the 'devices signed in to the Apple Account' phrasing come from the vocab's iCloud sentence.

S10.why: A fixed phrase Chinese buyers know for a one-off purchase; says nothing recurs without the word subscription, which S11 carries.

S11.s: 没有订阅，没有广告，也不用注册账号。
S11.back: no subscription, no advertising, also not-need register account.
S11.why: Three spoken clauses with 也 on the last, warmer than a 无…无… slogan; 账号 is the sign-up account, a different thing from the Apple 账户.

S12.why: The exact wording zh-Hans iOS apps use for the App Store restore action.

S13.why: Progressive 正在 plus the single ellipsis character U+2026, as Apple's zh-Hans system strings write in-progress states.

S14.why: '¥8 永久解锁' is the native paywall button for a one-off unlock; 4 CJK plus the price, no 立即 or other urgency.

S15.why: The same action with the price dropped, so the button keeps its words when the price arrives.

S16.why: The standard Chinese 'not now': putting it off, never refusing.

S17.why: The verb iOS zh-Hans puts on its close buttons.

S18.why: 归你了 is warm and a little proud, and 全都 covers the items and all the new room; no exclamation mark.

S19.s: 谢谢你的购买。“剪切片段”由一个人独立开发，你的支持让它能继续做下去。
S19.back: thank you your purchase. 'Cut-clip-pieces' by one person independently developed, your support lets it able continue make onward.
S19.why: Names the one maker plainly; app name in “” as Apple zh-Hans prose does, which also keeps it apart from the item word.

S20.s: 欢迎回来，你之前的购买已恢复。
S20.back: welcome back, your before purchase already restored.
S20.why: 欢迎回来 greets a returning buyer; 已恢复 echoes the 恢复购买 link they tapped.

S21.s: %2$lld 个免费剪切片段已用 %1$lld 个
S21.why: Spoken twin of S5 with the same positional order; no period for a VoiceOver label.

S22.s: 已有 %lld 个剪切片段，现在可存 %@ 个
S22.back: already have 5 (mw) cut-clip-pieces, now can store 5,000 (mw)
S22.why: Chinese nouns do not inflect, so '%lld 个' reads right for 1, 2, 5 and 21.

S23.s: 已解锁，现在可存 %@ 个剪切片段
S23.back: already unlocked, now can store 5,000 (mw) cut-clip-pieces
S23.why: Short announcement; subject dropped as Chinese does when the screen already shows what was unlocked.

S24.why: States the fact with no subject and no blame; 5 CJK.

S25.s: 暂时无法连接 App Store，请稍后再试。
S25.back: temporarily unable connect App Store, please later again try.
S25.why: 暂时 says it is passing; 请稍后再试 is the stock zh-Hans retry line readers expect.

S26.s: App Store 没有确认这笔购买。
S26.back: App Store did-not confirm this (mw-sum) purchase.
S26.why: 笔 is the measure word for a payment; 没有 reads calmer than 未 in a sentence.

S27.s: 这台设备登录的 Apple 账户没有购买过“剪切片段”。
S27.back: this (mw) device logged-in Apple account has-not purchased-ever 'Cut-clip-pieces'.
S27.why: 过 marks 'never at any time'; Apple 账户 from vocab; app name quoted as in Apple zh-Hans prose.

S28.s: 免费版可存 %lld 个剪切片段。解锁一次“剪切片段”，就能想存多少存多少。
S28.back: free version can store 5 (mw) cut-clip-pieces. unlock one time 'Cut-clip-pieces', then can want store how-many store how-many.
S28.why: 想存多少存多少 is the native spoken way to say 'as many as you like', fit for Siri.

S29.why: Compact subtitle under the list title; 4 CJK plus the pair, inside the 9 budget.

K1.s: %lld 个免费剪切片段已存满，轻点解锁
K1.back: 5 (mw) free cut-clip-pieces already saved-full, tap unlock
K1.why: 存满 matches S3; 轻点 is Apple zh-Hans for tap; about 16 CJK on one line.

M1.why: Verb-led window title like Mac menu names 关于… and 退出…, which carry the app name without quotes.

M2.why: M1 as a button that opens a window, with the single ellipsis character as Mac zh-Hans menus write it.

M3.why: The row label is the thing itself, same phrase as on the iPhone sheet.

M4.why: A bare number pair is how zh-Hans Settings show a used-of-total value; same order as English, so no positional forms.

M5.why: Status in three characters, the Settings row already names the app.

M6.s: 购买一次，iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上的“剪切片段”都会解锁。
M6.back: buy one time, iPhone, iPad and Mac on's 'Cut-clip-pieces' all will unlock.
M6.why: Same 购买一次 opening as S9; device list as in S8.

M7.s: 已在登录此 Apple 账户的 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上解锁。
M7.back: already on logged-in this Apple account's iPhone, iPad and Mac on unlocked.
M7.why: 此 fits a Settings footnote; Apple 账户 and the device list as elsewhere.

M8.s: 你在“剪切片段”改为免费下载之前就买下了它，所以它会一直保持解锁。谢谢你的支持。
M8.back: you at 'Cut-clip-pieces' changed-to free download before already bought it, so it will always keep unlocked. thank you your support.
M8.why: 就 stresses they bought early; 谢谢你的支持 matches S19's thanks.
